The '''1936–37 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by seven points over nearest rival [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. [[Dunfermline Athletic F.C.|Dunfermline Athletic]] and [[Albion Rovers F.C.|Albion Rovers]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1937–38 Scottish Division Two]].
